definition: Early warning and public alerting detect an impending hazard or communicate timely warnings to exposed people, institutions or responders so that protective action can be taken. Counts when the project finances, develops, procures, deploys or explicitly requires warning-generation systems, alert dissemination platforms, cell broadcast, emergency messaging or other dedicated public-warning capabilities. The defining function is warning or alerting: production of climate or hydrometeorological information without an alert function belongs to climate_information_systems, while post-event communications do not count merely because they support emergency response. A system performing both information and warning functions may receive both labels when the functions are separately explicit. Does not count for routine communications, call centers, general emergency response, post-disaster connectivity, existing warning systems mentioned only as context or lessons from previous disasters.
boundary: The project warns or alerts people or institutions about an imminent hazard.
note: Keep post-disaster communications outside this measure.
